content.short: Dapper Labs is a Web3 gaming studio creating blockchain-based games and NFT collectibles.
content.description: Founded in 2018, Dapper Labs is a software development company focused on creating blockchain-based games and NFTs for mainstream adoption. Its flagship platform, Dapper, provides an end-to-end solution for building Web3 applications on Flow, their native blockchain. Dapper Labs has produced NFT collections for notable sports brands such as NBA Top Shot and created popular blockchain games including CryptoKitties and Cheeze Wizards.
